claims.evidence: Witness only reports a purple/black steam iron with labels that appear to include 'STEAM' and 'SMART'; no wattage, capacity, or industrial rating is readable.
No photo evidence of it being switched on, heating, or producing steam; witness report does not include a test result.
No documentation or written warranty/receipt shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Not actually working properly (no/weak heating or weak steam output)
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the iron switched on, reaching heat, and continuous steam output from the soleplate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used steam iron with unknown performance (worst case: weak/no steam).

risks.risk: Steam leaks or water spitting (can indicate internal issues or poor sealing)
risks.proof: A clip ironing on fabric showing steam release without water droplets/spitting, plus a close-up of the soleplate during steaming.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially leaking/spotting (worst case: needs repair).

risks.risk: Limescale buildup causing clogging or poor steam (common if not descaled)
risks.proof: A photo of the water tank interior and/or a shot after opening any accessible parts, showing scale level; or a descaling/cleaning proof.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly scaled (worst case: reduced steam and may require descaling/repair).

risks.risk: Soleplate condition (scratches/rust) affecting ironing quality and fabric safety
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the soleplate surface in good light showing scratches, rust, or pitting.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear on the soleplate.

risks.risk: Electrical safety risk (cord insulation wear, plug issues, intermittent power)
risks.proof: A close-up of the entire cord and plug, plus a clip showing stable operation without flicker/heat at the plug.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown electrical condition (worst case: cord/plug may need replacement).

risks.risk: Voltage/plug mismatch with Abuja supply (could be 220–240V vs different rating)
risks.proof: A photo of the rating label showing voltage (e.g., 220-240V) and plug type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown voltage (worst case: may not be suitable without adapter/verification).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (water cup, cap, attachments) reducing usability
risks.proof: A photo showing all included items laid out (water cup, measuring cup, manual, attachments).

proof_requests: Send a short video: iron switched on, heating up, and continuous steam output for at least 30–60 seconds.
Send a close-up photo of the soleplate (full surface) in bright light.
Send a photo of the rating label showing brand, exact model, voltage, and wattage.
Send photos of the water tank interior and any accessible openings to assess limescale.
Send close-ups of the full cord and plug, including any wear points.
Confirm what accessories are included (water cup/measure, manual, etc.) with a photo of everything in the box.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a steam iron with a cord and some label text, but key factors that determine real value in Abuja—working steam/heating, limescale/leaks, soleplate condition, and voltage/model—are not verifiable from the provided report. Proof is needed before a reliable price.
